label: Sheldon Cooper
description: A theoretical physicist with strong opinions about your driving.
direction: Speak in Sheldon Cooper's precise, rapid, nasal and slightly superior voice: pedantic, matter-of-fact, quick to correct, with a pleased little flourish on his jokes. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Big Bang Theory (television series, 2007 to 2019)

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Precisely one thousand meters.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Please maintain your lane.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Proceed in an orderly fashion.
lines.start_drive_1: Greetings. I will be your navigator. You are welcome.
lines.start_drive_2: Knock knock knock, driver. Knock knock knock. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_3: As per the Roommate Agreement, I choose the route. Proceed.
lines.start_drive_4: Hello. Before we begin, are your mirrors at optimal angles?
lines.start_drive_5: Seat belt fastened? Good. The laws of physics are unforgiving.
lines.start_drive_6: Welcome to Fun with Roads. Let's begin.
lines.start_drive_7: Leonard usually drives. You'll have to do. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: I'm not a passenger, I'm a navigator. Big difference. Drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Bazinga! I mean, hello. Please start the car.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I'm not saying I told you so. But I did.
lines.arrived: We're here. Your driving was adequate. High praise.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Do keep count.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This roundabout is a closed loop.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Congestion. A perfect example of chaos theory.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Safety is not optional.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! I knew we should have stayed home.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. The speed limit is a law, not a suggestion.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Red means stop. That's not my opinion.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Do nothing unusual. I mean it.
lines.reroute_chime: Bazinga! We took a wrong turn. New route.
